Citadel Electronics browse by type distortion/fuzz/overdrive overdrive browse by enclosure pedal events 2025 Guitar Summit 2025 Citadel Electronics Plutonium Overdrive Published on September 26, 2025 Citadel Electronics overdrive pedal Guitar Summit 2025 Information Plutonium Overdrive is an analog op-amp-based distortion pedal engineered for bass, designed to deliver both modern and organic tones. Its defining feature is the Crush control, which tailors the low-end response before distortion, offering a spectrum of sounds from tight, aggressive distortion with strong low-end punch to warm, saturated fuzz. The pedal also features a clean blend circuit for precise control of dry and processed signals, along with active bass and treble EQ shaping. A true bypass relay system with an initial state switch allows users to configure whether the pedal powers on in engaged or bypassed mode. Controls Level : Sets the output volume. Crush : Shapes the low-end response before distortion, ranging from tight modern tones to thick fuzz. Blend : Mixes the clean and distorted signals. Drive : Controls the amount of distortion. Bass : Active shelving EQ for low frequencies, ±18 dB adjustment. Treble : Active shelving EQ for high frequencies, ±15 dB adjustment. Connections Input jack Output jack Technical Specifications Input impedance: 1 MΩ Output impedance: 1 kΩ Power supply: 9 VDC, center negative, 50 mA (power supply not included) Dimensions: 114 mm (L) x 62 mm (W) x 58 mm (H) Weight: 250 g Highlights Analog op-amp bass distortion with wide tonal range Crush control transitions between tight distortion and warm fuzz Clean blend for mixing dry and effected signals Active bass and treble EQ with significant boost/cut range True bypass relay with configurable startup state Reviews myFXDB user reviews No reviews yet  + Add your review Links Citadel Electronics Citadel Electronics Plutonium Overdrive Where to find one?
